quote.text: Forsan et haec olim meminisse iuvabit.
quote.english: Perhaps one day it will be a pleasure to remember even this.

poem.text:
Had I the heavens' embroidered cloths,
Enwrought with golden and silver light,
The blue and the dim and the dark cloths
Of night and light and the half-light,
I would spread the cloths under your feet:
But I am poor, and have only my dreams;
I have spread my dreams under your feet;
Tread softly because you tread on my dreams.
poem.note: First printed as "Aedh Wishes for the Cloths of Heaven", one of three named voices Yeats later folded into a single "he".

song.title: Spiegel im Spiegel
song.note: Mirror in the mirror: a piano triad and a violin line that never hurries, written just before he left Estonia.
